2026-2027.summary: Oh, Mary! appears in the 2026-2027 slate for the first time this week, posting $1.87M in gross revenue at 92.2% capacity—solid performance for a comparable-sized venue. Waitress has not reported in the Broadway League feed for 224 consecutive weeks; while absence this extended is uncommon, roughly one-third of shows with similar gaps have returned to the feed. Confirm Waitress's status with booking partners to clarify its 2026-2027 scheduling.
